fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole car, a 2006 Lexus ES330 sedan.
findings: Headlight lenses look hazy and yellowed on both sides in the front three-quarter shots

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the ES330. The headlights look a bit hazy in the photos, and a buff and wax would bring more depth back to that green paint. We do pre-sale details and headlight restoration and come to you. Would you like a quote?
